🥬 Seasoned Spinach

✔ Ingredients

150g spinach

A pinch of salt (for blanching)

1 tablespoon Korean soup soy sauce

1/2 tsp garlic powder

1 teaspoon–1 tablespoon sesame oil

Plenty of sesame seeds

✔ Instructions

1. Wash the spinach thoroughly several times.

2. Add salt to boiling water and blanch briefly.

3. Rinse in cold water and squeeze out excess water.

4. Cut into bite-sized pieces.

5. Add Korean soup soy sauce, garlic powder, sesame oil, and sesame seeds, then mix well.

6. Taste and finish.

✔ Tip

Do not blanch for too long; just wilt the leaves (approx. 5–15 seconds).
